name: science-workshop
description: Plan a fair comparison and inspect observations.

interface.longDescription: Plan a fair comparison and inspect observations. Includes a launch screen, side-panel workspace, editable input controls and real computations: Build a controlled experiment; Compare repeated measurements; Compare density with a reference. Imports and exports its own versioned documents. Uses supplied information; no live lookup or background monitoring.
defaultPrompt: Help me build a controlled experiment.

prompts: Help me build a controlled experiment.
Help me compare density with a reference.

positive.description: Open the launch screen without calculating.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the actual launch screen with three distinct workflow cards. No computation or file access.

positive.prompt: Open the Evidence Bench: Science workspace beside this chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the editable workspace and labeled illustrative inputs. No computation starts automatically.

positive.description: Build a controlled experiment. Reproducible inputs: {"question":"How does light affect plant growth?","changed_variable":"Hours of light","measured_variable":"Height in cm after 14 days","controls":["Water volume","Plant species"],"levels":["4 hours","8 hours"],"repeats":3}
positive.prompt: Help me build a controlled experiment with these supplied values: {"question":"How does light affect plant growth?","changed_variable":"Hours of light","measured_variable":"Height in cm after 14 days","controls":["Water volume","Plant species"],"levels":["4 hours","8 hours"],"repeats":3}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses science_workshop_experiment_plan with the supplied inputs. Returns {"question":"How does light affect plant growth?","changed_variable":"Hours of light","measured_variable":"Height in cm after 14 days","controls":["Water volume","Plant species"],"levels":["4 hours","8 hours"],"repeats":3,"total_trials":6,"trial_sheet":[{"condition":"4 hours","repeat":1,"measurement":null},{"condition":"4 hours","repeat":2,"measurement":null},{"condition":"4 hours","repeat":3,"measurement":null},{"condition":"8 hours","repeat":1,"measurement":null},{"condition":"8 hours","repeat":2,"measurement":null},{"condition":"8 hours","repeat":3,"measurement":null}]}. Shows the actual experiment result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Compare repeated measurements. Reproducible inputs: {"groups":[{"name":"4 hours","measurements":[3,4,5]},{"name":"8 hours","measurements":[6,7,8]}]}
positive.prompt: Help me compare repeated measurements with these supplied values: {"groups":[{"name":"4 hours","measurements":[3,4,5]},{"name":"8 hours","measurements":[6,7,8]}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses science_workshop_measurement_summary with the supplied inputs. Returns {"groups":[{"name":"4 hours","count":3,"mean":4,"range":2,"values":[3,4,5]},{"name":"8 hours","count":3,"mean":7,"range":2,"values":[6,7,8]}],"note":"Descriptive comparison; no causal or significance claim is inferred."}. Shows the actual bars result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Compare density with a reference. Reproducible inputs: {"mass_g":54,"volume_ml":20,"reference_density":1}
positive.prompt: Help me compare density with a reference with these supplied values: {"mass_g":54,"volume_ml":20,"reference_density":1}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses science_workshop_density_lab with the supplied inputs. Returns {"density_g_per_ml":2.7,"relative_to_reference":2.7,"formula":"density = mass ÷ volume"}. Shows the actual measurement result. Does not fabricate external data.
